# tests/integration/test_order_fulfillment.py
import pytest
from testcontainers.compose import DockerCompose

@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def services():
    """The containers breathe together. Isolated. Safe."""
    with DockerCompose(".", compose_file_name="docker-compose.test.yml") as compose:
        compose.wait_for("http://localhost:8080/health")
        yield compose

@pytest.fixture
def order_context(services, db_session):
    """Each test gets its own universe. No contamination."""
    ctx = OrderTestContext(db_session)
    yield ctx
    ctx.cleanup()  # Ashes to ashes

# HAPPY PATH - The light before the dark
class TestOrderHappyPath:
    def test_complete_order_flow(self, order_context):
        """Order → Reserve → Pay → Notify. The dance completes."""
        order = order_context.create_order(items=[{"sku": "WIDGET-1", "qty": 2}])
        
        result = order_service.submit(order)
        
        assert result.status == "CONFIRMED"
        assert inventory_service.reserved(order.id) == True
        assert payment_service.charged(order.id) == order.total
        assert_notification_sent(order.customer_email, "ORDER_CONFIRMED")

# FAILURE SCENARIOS - Two by two, hands of blue
class TestInventoryFailures:
    def test_insufficient_stock_prevents_payment(self, order_context):
        """Can't take what isn't there."""
        order_context.set_stock("WIDGET-1", quantity=0)
        order = order_context.create_order(items=[{"sku": "WIDGET-1", "qty": 5}])
        
        result = order_service.submit(order)
        
        assert result.status == "FAILED"
        assert payment_service.charged(order.id) is None  # Never touched

    def test_inventory_timeout_triggers_retry(self, order_context, chaos_monkey):
        """Three tries. The system is patient."""
        chaos_monkey.delay_service("inventory", seconds=2, times=2)
        order = order_context.create_order()
        
        result = order_service.submit(order, timeout=10)
        
        assert result.status == "CONFIRMED"
        assert chaos_monkey.call_count("inventory") == 3

class TestCompensatingTransactions:
    def test_payment_failure_unreserves_inventory(self, order_context):
        """What is taken must be returned."""
        order_context.force_payment_decline()
        initial_stock = inventory_service.get_stock("WIDGET-1")
        order = order_context.create_order(items=[{"sku": "WIDGET-1", "qty": 2}])
        
        result = order_service.submit(order)
        
        assert result.status == "FAILED"
        assert inventory_service.get_stock("WIDGET-1") == initial_stock  # Restored

class TestAsyncMessaging:
    def test_notification_eventual_delivery(self, order_context, message_queue):
        """Messages find their way. Eventually."""
        order = order_context.create_order()
        order_service.submit(order)
        
        message = message_queue.wait_for(
            queue="notifications",
            predicate=lambda m: m.order_id == order.id,
            timeout=5
        )
        
        assert message.type == "ORDER_CONFIRMED"
